summary: Join our Grievance Redress & Social Protection Case Management Course. Learn effective strategies to address community issues and support those in need.
lede: Grievance redress and case management for social protection helps teams turn complaints into a consistent, accountable workflow. You will learn to capture issues, assess urgency and vulnerability, investigate concerns, assign responsibility, protect sensitive information, communicate decisions, and close cases with a clear audit trail. The course covers accessible intake, escalation pathways, social registry and payment-record checks, response-time monitoring, and corrective action. Through controlled case data, templates, and practical scenarios, you will build tools for reliable case handling, management learning, and ongoing service improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle social protection complaints, appeals, referrals, eligibility concerns, payment disputes, and case records. It suits foundation-level practitioners and experienced staff who need a structured approach to grievance redress and case management.
modules: Data Governance and Digital Case Management
prerequisites: No formal certification or programming background is required. You should have basic familiarity with a social protection programme, public service delivery, complaints handling, case records, or beneficiary support. Working knowledge of spreadsheets helps with dashboard exercises, but the course uses guided templates and does not require coding. Advanced digital topics, including AI-assisted categorization and automated case alerts, are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels. The course does not cover production-system engineering, legal advice, or enterprise-scale software implementation.
